label: Counterfactuals
description: Changes one historical or current condition to build a parallel reality, exposing contingency in technologies, institutions, values, artifacts, and behavior.

zh.label: 反事实推演
zh.description: 改变一个历史或当下条件，构建平行现实，揭示技术、制度、价值、物件与行为原本可以不同的可能性。

text_output_forms.primary_template: before/after divergence table, causal ledger, parallel-present fragment, and inevitability questions

required_blocks.title: Fragment from the parallel present
required_blocks.purpose: Write a short institution, notice, diary, or routine fragment that makes the alternate world tangible.

required_blocks.title: What does the present call inevitable?

text_output_forms.presentation_rule: Keep the altered fact singular and causal links inspectable. Use actual table blocks, never Markdown pipe tables.
text_output_forms.conciseness_rule: Follow output_budget: at most 3 rows or items per structured block, and no repeated prose outside the blocks.

theory_mapping.source_notes: 思辨设计tools-3.pdf pages 7-8, Counterfactuals / 反事实推演.

model_constraints: Change one identifiable historical fact or current condition.
Name the altered fact before describing consequences.
Keep causal changes traceable to the altered fact.
Use the parallel reality to question the inevitability of the present.

For embodied technologies, preferentially alter a world-level premise such as the necessity of the human form, the arrangement of care and work, the meaning of autonomy, or the legitimacy of deployment; do not reduce the counterfactual to swapping a component unless the source itself makes that component the central claim.

When a humanoid form is central, include a branch where the human body never became the default delivery form and compare it with environmental redesign or distributed non-humanoid systems; identify which claimed value remains after the form premise is removed.
For text outputs, return the package text_blocks sequence; show causal links and counter-questions instead of a single alternate-world summary.
Preserve the required tool information structure while using the package output_budget; remove repeated framing and keep evidence, tables, and questions concise.

reject_if: alternate world is pure fantasy without relation to present

recommendation.reason: Counterfactuals need a named altered fact and traceable causal branch; text is the clearest first output before generating parallel-world artifacts.
best_when: The input depends on a historical, institutional, or technological assumption.
The user wants to question whether the present arrangement was inevitable.
The output needs causal explanation rather than only atmosphere.

avoid: alternate world with no explicit changed fact
fantasy setting disconnected from the present

warnings: Do not recommend image-only output until the altered fact and causal chain are legible.
